_source: SciPrompt (You et al., EMNLP 2024), https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.350/. Instruction: Appendix G 'Instructions of LLMs' (p. 6102); lower-case output rule and scaffold replaced by choice criteria. Options: the 19 Semantic Scholar fields of study of the released label set (repo label_mappings/S2ORC_label_mappings.json @cc6db91; paper Table 11, Appendix B: abstracts with a single discipline label from the 2023-11-07 S2 release). Semantic Scholar publishes no definitions for these fields, so each option is its name only.
